description: This Java class defines enumerations and conversion methods for client statuses, legal forms, and transaction types within the Fineract project.

classes.name: ClientEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to convert client-related enumeration values into EnumOptionData objects for use in the application.

methods.name: status(Integer statusId)
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a client status based on its integer ID.

methods.name: status(ClientStatus status)
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given ClientStatus enum.

methods.name: legalForm(Integer statusId)
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a legal form based on its integer ID.

methods.name: legalForm(LegalForm legalForm)
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given LegalForm enum.

methods.name: legalForm(LegalForm[] legalForms)
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData for an array of LegalForm enums.

methods.name: clientTransactionType(int id)
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a client transaction type based on its integer ID.

methods.name: clientTransactionType(ClientTransactionType clientTransactionType)
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given ClientTransactionType enum.

methods.name: clientTransactionType(ClientTransactionType[] clientTransactionTypes)
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData for an array of ClientTransactionType enums.
